about: One video slot per printed demo chip. Videos live in GitHub Release assets (tag demo-videos), never in git: see docs/videos/README.md. Generated by tools/module_catalog.py; url, release_tag, recorded and duration_s are kept across regenerations and filled by tools/publish_video.py.
